title: Identifiable Return in Memristive Associative Memory: A Generative Collapse Dynamics Analysis of Recurrent Pattern Completion
source_native_claims: Manuscript type (owner-supplied): formal companion method with frozen retrospective source-data analysis of He et al. (SRC-000051).

Contributions (owner-supplied): an identity-aware recovery certificate; a reproducible retrospective audit of ten released trajectories; target-specific acceptance regions; reconstruction residual; local contraction; implementation-error burden; separation from competing memories; and a prospective test design.
